content.text: {"headline":"Approve P4 (overtime, chat deflection and callback): the only option predicted to reach the 80% target over 10:15-12:15, at 81.7% for ₹6,321.","why":"Calls on general are running long because of the CRM search slowdown (P2 incident INC-20261021-5862, searches taking 20–40 s). Handle time reached 646 s at 10:00 against about 350–376 s forecast. Volume and staffing are close to plan. Service level fell to 14.7% with 18 abandons in that interval. Doing nothing is predicted to give 58.3% over the window, with general at 33.8%. P4 combines the free levers (delayed breaks, cancelled coaching, 3 agents moved from payments for 10:15-11:00) with overtime for 30 general agents from 10:45-12:00, 20% chat deflection of balance and offer enquiries, and IVR callback until 11:45. It is predicted to lift the window to 81.7% and cut abandons to 4.3%. The rest of the day is expected to finish at 88.5%. No policy rules are broken.","trade_offs":["Cost: P4 is the most expensive at ₹6,321. P3 (overtime for 25 agents, ₹4,575) saves ₹1,746 but reaches only 73.3% with 6.4% abandons, so it misses the target.","Cheaper options fall well short. P2 (chat deflection, ₹471) gives 65.4%. P1 (₹75) gives 57.5%, slightly below no action, because general drops to 26.7%.","General is still below target even under P4, at 69.3%. The overall 81.7% depends on payments being strong at 90.6%.","Payments is not put at risk: it stays at 90.6% despite lending 3 agents and delaying its breaks from 11:00-11:45."],"watch":"Track handle time and the CRM incident. If search speed recovers, consider stopping overtime early to save cost. If the incident worsens or overtime take-up falls short of 30 agents, general will slip further and the plan should be reviewed."}
